169	function lWire(st: TileStore, x0: number, y0: number, x1: number, y1: number): void {

179	  }

225	function placeSandTrap(st: TileStore, rng: RNG, i: number, j: number): boolean {
226	  const num2 = 4, num3 = 25;
227	  let y = j;
228	  while (!st.flags[st.idx(i, y)] && y < st.h - 200) y++;
229	  const gi = st.idx(i, y);

231	  const t = st.type[gi];

233	  if (st.wall[gi] !== 216 && st.wall[gi] !== 187) return false;
234	  const j1 = y - 1;
235	  let sandTop = -1;
236	  for (let yy = j1; yy > j1 - 30; yy--) {
237	    if (st.flags[st.idx(i, yy)]) {
238	      if (st.type[st.idx(i, yy)] !== SANDSTONE) return false;
239	      sandTop = yy;
240	      break;
241	    }
242	  }
243	  const pocketW = rng.int(6, 11);   // Next(6,12)
244	  const pocketH = rng.int(6, 13);   // Next(6,14)
245	  if (sandTop <= -1 || j1 - sandTop < pocketH + num2) return false;
246	  // ±25 无线/箱/画/门/闸/牌（cs:19987-19995）

251	      const ii = st.idx(xx, yy);
252	      const tt = st.type[ii];
253	      if (st.wire[ii] || tt === CHEST || tt === CHEST2 || tt === DOOR || tt === GATE || tt === SIGN) return false;
254	    }
255	  }
256	  // ±2 下 3 格实心
257	  for (let dx = -2; dx <= 2; dx++) {
258	    for (let dy = 1; dy <= 3; dy++) {
259	      if (!st.flags[st.idx(i + dx, j1 + dy)]) return false;
260	    }
261	  }
262	  // 腰线全空 + 下方实心率 75%（cs:20006-20024）
263	  const mid = Math.floor((j1 + sandTop) / 2);
264	  let solidN = 0;
265	  for (let dx = -pocketW; dx <= pocketW; dx++) {
266	    if (st.flags[st.idx(i + dx, mid)]) return false;
267	    for (let dy = sandTop - pocketH; dy <= sandTop; dy++) {
268	      const ii = st.idx(i + dx, dy);
269	      if (st.flags[ii] && solidAt(st, i + dx, dy)) {
270	        if (isOre(st.type[ii]) || st.type[ii] === HARDSAND) return false;
271	        solidN++;
272	      }
273	    }
274	  }
275	  if (solidN < (pocketW * 2 + 1) * (pocketH + 1) * 0.75) return false;
276	  // 掏沙穴 + 壳（cs:20028-20064）：中空纯沙，底/边砂岩，顶硬化沙

279	      const xx = i + dx, yy = dy;
280	      if (!st.inBounds(xx, yy)) continue;
281	      const flag = st.flags[st.idx(xx, yy)] && solidAt(st, xx, yy);
282	      if (dy === sandTop) {
283	        if (!flag) st.setTileSilent(xx, yy, SANDSTONE);
284	      } else if (dy === sandTop - pocketH) {
285	        st.setTileSilent(xx, yy, !flag || !st.flags[st.idx(xx, yy - 1)] ? SANDSTONE : HARDSAND);

290	      }
291	    }
292	  }

317	      let y = rng.int(gs.worldSurface, st.h - 211);           // Next(surface, h-210)
318	      // oceanDepths 回避（cs:18821）——海滩带是常量 beachDistance=380（cs:4102），

320	      const oceanTop = (gs.worldSurface + gs.rockLevel) / 2 + 40;
321	      while (y <= oceanTop && (x < gs.beachDistance || x > st.w - gs.beachDistance)) {
322	        x = rng.int(200, st.w - 201);
323	        y = rng.int(gs.worldSurface, st.h - 211);
324	      }
325	      if (st.wall[st.idx(x, y)] === 0 && placeTrap(st, rng, gs, x, y, -1)) break;

327	  }
328	  const sandTries = st.w * 0.003;
329	  for (let n = 0; n < sandTries; n++) {
330	    for (let k = 0; k < 20000; k++) {
331	      const x = rng.int(Math.floor(st.w * 0.15), Math.floor(st.w * 0.85) - 1);
332	      const y = rng.int(gs.worldSurface + 20, st.h - 211);
333	      if (st.wall[st.idx(x, y)] === 187 && placeSandTrap(st, rng, x, y)) break;
334	    }
335	  }
336	  // ★pass 尾还原（cs:18897 `Main.tileSolid[379] = true`）
337	  flipGenSolid([379], true);

195	/** StructureMap.CanPlace（StructureMap.cs:19-56）的移植：
196	 *  ① 越界拒绝（cs:28：area 超出 [0,w-1]×[0,h-1] 即 false）；
197	 *  ② 与全部既有保护矩形（各自已含 pad 扩张）按候选 pad 扩张后不相交（cs:32-39）；
198	 *  ③ validTiles 内容扫描（cs:40-53）：**pad 扩张域内**每个 active tile 的 type 须
199	 *    validTiles[type]（默认=GeneralPlacementTiles 黑名单外全放）。传 `st` 即启用
200	 *    （默认 forbid 集）；自定义白名单的调用方（HouseUtils.BlacklistedTiles /
201	 *    EnchantedSwordBiome 派生表）传自己的 forbid 集,`null` 显式关闭扫描。
202	 *    域为半开 [x0,x1)×[y0,y1)（cs:40-43 j<Width/k<Height）;越界格跳过（原版
203	 *    pad 域不做二次界检,靠调用域保证;此处安全跳过等价）。 */
204	export function canPlaceStructure(
205	  gs: GenState, rect: { x0: number; y0: number; x1: number; y1: number }, pad: number,
206	  st?: TileStore, forbid?: Set<number> | null,
207	): boolean {
208	  if (rect.x0 < 0 || rect.y0 < 0 || rect.x1 > gs.genW - 1 || rect.y1 > gs.genH - 1) return false;
209	  const px0 = rect.x0 - pad, py0 = rect.y0 - pad, px1 = rect.x1 + pad, py1 = rect.y1 + pad;
210	  for (const r of gs.protectedRects) {
211	    if (px0 < r.x1 && r.x0 < px1 && py0 < r.y1 && r.y0 < py1) return false;
212	  }
213	  if (st && forbid !== null) {
214	    const bad = forbid ?? GENERAL_PLACEMENT_FORBID;
215	    for (let x = px0; x < px1; x++) {
216	      for (let y = py0; y < py1; y++) {
217	        if (!st.inBounds(x, y)) continue;
218	        const i = st.idx(x, y);
219	        if (st.flags[i] && bad.has(st.type[i])) return false;
220	      }
221	    }
222	  }
223	  return true;
224	}

231	    x0: rect.x0 - pad, y0: rect.y0 - pad,
232	    x1: rect.x1 + pad, y1: rect.y1 + pad,
233	    pad,
234	  });
235	}

              Tile tileSafely1 = Framing.GetTileSafely(i, y - 2);

                return;
              continue;
            case 132:

            default:
              Tile tileSafely2 = Framing.GetTileSafely(i, y + 1);

                return;
              continue;

        }
      }
      if (type == (ushort) 132)
      {
        bool flag = true;
        if (Main.tile[x - 1, y + 1] == null)
          Main.tile[x - 1, y + 1] = new Tile();
        if (Main.tile[x, y + 1] == null)
          Main.tile[x, y + 1] = new Tile();
        if (!Main.tile[x - 1, y + 1].nactive() || !WorldGen.SolidTile2(x - 1, y + 1) && !Main.tileTable[(int) Main.tile[x - 1, y + 1].type])
          flag = false;
        if (!Main.tile[x, y + 1].nactive() || !WorldGen.SolidTile2(x, y + 1) && !Main.tileTable[(int) Main.tile[x, y + 1].type])

export function findFragments(st: TileStore, onlyKeys?: ReadonlySet<string>): Array<{ x: number; y: number; key: string; type: number }> {
  const out: Array<{ x: number; y: number; key: string; type: number }> = [];
  const multi = collectMultiDefs().filter((m) => !onlyKeys || onlyKeys.has(m.key));
  const byType = new Map(multi.map((m) => [m.type, m]));
  for (let y = 0; y < st.h; y++) {
    for (let x = 0; x < st.w; x++) {
      const t = st.type[st.idx(x, y)];
      const m = byType.get(t);
      if (!m) continue;
      let ok = false;
      for (let ay = y; ay > y - m.h && !ok; ay--) {
        for (let ax = x; ax > x - m.w; ax--) {
          let full = true;
          for (let dy = 0; dy < m.h && full; dy++) {
            for (let dx = 0; dx < m.w; dx++) {
              const nx = ax + dx, ny = ay + dy;
              if (nx < 0 || ny < 0 || nx >= st.w || ny >= st.h || st.type[st.idx(nx, ny)] !== t) { full = false; break; }
            }
          }
          if (full) { ok = true; break; }
        }
      }
      if (!ok) out.push({ x, y, key: m.key, type: t });
    }
  }
  return out;
}

	public static void TileFrame(int i, int j, bool resetFrame = false, bool noBreak = false)
	{
		if (i <= 5 || j <= 5 || i >= Main.maxTilesX - 5 || j >= Main.maxTilesY - 5 || Main.tile[i, j] == null)
		{
			return;
		}
		MapUpdateQueue.Add(i, j);
		try
		{
			Tile tile = Main.tile[i, j];
			if (!tile.active())
			{
				tile.halfBrick(halfBrick: false);
				tile.ClearBlockPaintAndCoating();
				tile.slope(0);
			}
			if (tile.liquid > 0 && Main.netMode != 1 && !generatingWorld)
			{
				Liquid.AddWater(i, j);
			}
			if (!tile.active())
			{
				return;
			}
			int type = tile.type;
